quote.text:
I am not a gamer. I don't know the first thing about building games. But I was able to get Claude Opus 5.5 to build the first level of INSIDE by Playdead, one of the best games of the 2010s.

It's not exactly one for one. It's a shorter and slightly different version of the opening forest chapter. Graphics & animations not as smooth. But this was done in 3 hours!

It was built using Godot, a free, open-source game engine. Opus wrote the code, the levels, the gameplay and the lighting. Art came from Codex image gen, sound from fal, and characters and textures from free open-source asset packs.

Just imagine where this goes. This is crazy. You can build AAA games now. This is wild.
